CREATE TABLE public.activities (
    id uuid NOT NULL,
    activity_code text,
    activity_date date NOT NULL,
    month text,
    rep_id uuid,
    rep_name text NOT NULL,
    company_name text NOT NULL,
    company_type text,
    contact_person text,
    phone text,
    interaction_type text,
    project_name text,
    notes text,
    region text,
    sqm_done numeric,
    sqm_expected numeric,
    submitted_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    submission_status text,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    company_id uuid,
    project_id uuid,
    contact_id uuid
);

CREATE TABLE public.branches (
    id uuid NOT NULL,
    name text NOT NULL,
    region text NOT NULL,
    is_active boolean,
    created_at timestamp with time zone
);

CREATE TABLE public.companies (
    id uuid NOT NULL,
    customer_code text,
    company_name text NOT NULL,
    company_name_normalized text,
    company_type text,
    contact1_name text,
    contact1_phone text,
    contact2_name text,
    contact2_phone text,
    region text,
    source text,
    primary_rep_id uuid,
    status text NOT NULL,
    notes text,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    branch_id uuid,
    source_detail text
);

CREATE TABLE public.company_holidays (
    id uuid NOT NULL,
    holiday_name text NOT NULL,
    date_from date NOT NULL,
    date_to date NOT NULL,
    created_by uuid,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE public.company_reps (
    id uuid NOT NULL,
    company_id uuid NOT NULL,
    rep_id uuid NOT NULL,
    role text NOT NULL,
    assigned_by uuid,
    assigned_at timestamp with time zone
);

CREATE TABLE public.contacts (
    id uuid NOT NULL,
    contact_code text,
    company_id uuid NOT NULL,
    full_name text NOT NULL,
    full_name_ar text,
    title text,
    phone text,
    whatsapp text,
    email text,
    is_primary boolean,
    notes text,
    created_by uuid,
    created_at timestamp with time zone,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone
);

CREATE TABLE public.duplicate_flags (
    id uuid NOT NULL,
    company_id_1 uuid,
    company_id_2 uuid,
    match_type text,
    match_key text,
    classification text NOT NULL,
    resolved_at timestamp with time zone,
    resolved_by uuid,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE public.notifications (
    id uuid NOT NULL,
    recipient_id uuid NOT NULL,
    type text NOT NULL,
    title text NOT NULL,
    body text,
    entity_type text,
    entity_id uuid,
    is_read boolean,
    created_at timestamp with time zone
);

CREATE TABLE public.project_history (
    id uuid NOT NULL,
    project_id uuid NOT NULL,
    changed_by uuid,
    changed_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    field_name text NOT NULL,
    old_value text,
    new_value text
);

CREATE TABLE public.project_reps (
    id uuid NOT NULL,
    project_id uuid NOT NULL,
    rep_id uuid NOT NULL,
    role text NOT NULL,
    sqm_split numeric,
    assigned_by uuid,
    assigned_at timestamp with time zone
);

CREATE TABLE public.projects (
    id uuid NOT NULL,
    project_code text,
    customer_id uuid,
    company_name text NOT NULL,
    project_name text,
    city text,
    stage text NOT NULL,
    quoted_sqm numeric NOT NULL,
    won_sqm numeric NOT NULL,
    assigned_rep_id uuid,
    quote_date date,
    expected_close date,
    notes text,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    contact_id uuid,
    stage_changed_at timestamp with time zone,
    next_follow_up date,
    loss_reason text,
    loss_notes text,
    project_date date NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE public.quotation_items (
    id uuid NOT NULL,
    quotation_id uuid NOT NULL,
    class text NOT NULL,
    fr_rating text NOT NULL,
    color_code text,
    supplier_code text,
    width_m numeric NOT NULL,
    width_is_custom boolean,
    length_m numeric NOT NULL,
    num_sheets integer NOT NULL,
    thickness_mm integer NOT NULL,
    price_per_sqm numeric,
    total_sqm numeric,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE public.quotation_services (
    id uuid NOT NULL,
    quotation_id uuid NOT NULL,
    service_type text NOT NULL,
    price_per_sqm numeric,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE public.quotations (
    id uuid NOT NULL,
    quotation_code text,
    project_id uuid NOT NULL,
    company_id uuid NOT NULL,
    rep_id uuid,
    coordinator_id uuid,
    product_type text,
    finish text,
    sqm_quoted numeric NOT NULL,
    price_per_sqm numeric,
    quote_date date NOT NULL,
    valid_until date,
    revision_number integer,
    status text,
    sqm_invoiced numeric,
    sqm_delivered numeric,
    notes text,
    created_at timestamp with time zone,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone,
    last_revised_at timestamp with time zone,
    erp_quotation_id text,
    cancellation_reason text,
    assigned_to_id uuid
);

CREATE TABLE public.rep_absences (
    id uuid NOT NULL,
    rep_id uuid NOT NULL,
    absence_type text NOT NULL,
    date_from date NOT NULL,
    date_to date NOT NULL,
    notes text,
    created_by uuid,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE public.rep_branch_summary (
    branch_id uuid,
    branch_name text,
    region text,
    rep_id uuid,
    rep_name text,
    monthly_target_sqm numeric,
    sqm_done_month numeric,
    activity_count_month bigint
);

CREATE TABLE public.rep_monthly_sqm (
    rep_id uuid,
    rep_name text,
    target_sqm numeric,
    month_start date,
    month_label text,
    achieved_sqm numeric,
    pipeline_sqm numeric,
    activity_count bigint
);

CREATE TABLE public.reps (
    id uuid NOT NULL,
    name text NOT NULL,
    email text NOT NULL,
    role text NOT NULL,
    status text NOT NULL,
    monthly_target_sqm numeric NOT NULL,
    auth_user_id uuid,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    branch_id uuid,
    language_pref text
);

CREATE TABLE public.stale_projects (
    id uuid,
    project_code text,
    project_name text,
    stage text,
    customer_id uuid,
    company_name text,
    next_follow_up date,
    stage_changed_at timestamp with time zone,
    time_in_stage interval,
    assigned_rep_name text
);
